description: This source file defines a data class 'SelectiveBuildOperator' and related functions used for managing information about specific PyTorch operators targeted for selective build configurations. The class includes attributes for operator name, usage flags, and debug info, along with methods to create instances from dictionaries, legacy names, and to convert instances to dictionaries. Functions for merging debug information, combining operator instances, merging operator dictionaries, and stripping overload names from operators are also included.
